user_reported_bug: iter25 critical: route-collision between /api/admin/users/{user_id}/suspend endpoints. The legacy handler in admin_routes.py (no password re-auth, no audit_log) shadowed the new secure handler in user360_routes.py, allowing any admin to suspend users without their password and without an audit trail.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused API/DB verification shows the critical suspend route-collision itself is fixed: wrong password returns 403 with no user/audit mutation, bodyless suspend returns 422, correct password stores suspended=true + reason and exactly one user_suspend audit row, and unsuspend writes user_unsuspend audit. However the requested backend regression is not fully green: /api/engines/instant-win/{contest_id}/reveal returns 404 because the engines public_router is not registered, so iter25 still has 1 failing test.
